## IKEv2 tunnel tests

- Manual IKEv2 URL Test and TCPing wait up to 20 seconds for another tunnel test to finish. A brief overlap no longer causes an immediate failure.
- Includes the IKEv2 certificate import fix from 5.8.19-r1.

OpenWrt 25.12 and later use the `.apk` package. OpenWrt 24.10 and 23.05 use the `.ipk` package. Match the filename to `DISTRIB_ARCH` in `/etc/openwrt_release`.
